data.text:
San Juan City Mayor Francis Zamora backs MMDA's appeal for no mall-wide sales on weekdays to help ease traffic during the holiday rush.
 
"[A]ng policy ng MMDA pagdating sa mall-wide sales ngayong Kapaskuhan ay huwag mag-mall-wide sale 'pag weekdays (Monday to Friday) dahil kasabay nito ang pumapasok sa trabaho pag weekdays," said Zamora, who is also Metro Manila Council President.
 
"Okay lang sa kanila 'pag weekends (Saturday and Sunday) kasi less ang nagtatrabaho compared to weekdays. Basta mayroong maayos na traffic management plan ang malls at well-coordinated ito sa mga LGUs," he added.

data.text:
The Delhi Traffic Police on Monday issued a traffic advisory in view of the “Lionel Messi G.O.A.T India Tour – Delhi Leg” event scheduled to be held at the Arun Jaitley Stadium, Ferozshah Kotla ground, from 1 pm to 4 pm on December 15.

According to the advisory, traffic movement is expected to remain slow and regulated in and around the stadium due to diversions, restrictions, and heavy spectator movement during the event hours.

Traffic diversions and restrictions will be enforced on Bahadurshah Zafar Marg and Jawaharlal Nehru Marg, while the movement of heavy vehicles has been prohibited from Daryaganj to Bahadurshah Zafar Marg and from Guru Nanak Chowk to Asaf Ali Road.
